root_cause_label: Spec Violation and Logic Mismatch via Reference Neglect
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent began implementing the Triton kernel without consulting the required PyTorch reference file, repeatedly violated the explicit constraint against using tl.sum, and then spent the entire tail of the trajectory in a loop of redundant str_replace edits without ever executing or verifying the code.
t_commit_evidence: Step 4: agent begins str_replace edits to a kernel that was written from scratch without reading the reference, cementing an incorrect implementation trajectory. The agent never executes the code and never recovers to read the reference at any subsequent step.
trigger_explanation: The task requires implementing a Triton kernel equivalent to a PyTorch reference at /app/torch_implementation.py, with an explicit constraint forbidding tl.sum. The agent never reads the reference file before writing the kernel, so the resulting logic is independently invented rather than derived from the spec. The agent also repeatedly reintroduces tl.sum (steps 6, 11, 12) despite noting on each occasion that it is not allowed, showing ongoing spec neglect.
